lines.translation: God exists in the beginning, in the middle and in the end.
Whatever the Creator Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhau mitiaa saadhasa(n)g te daalid na koee ghaalakaa ||6||
lines.translation: Doubt and fear are erased, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and then one is not afflicted by deadly pain. ||6||
I sing the most Sublime Bani, the Word of the Lord of the Universe.
I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saadh Sangat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਬਾਸਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਲਕਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: baasan met nibaasan hoeeai kalamal sagale jaalakaa ||7||
lines.translation: Eradicating desire, I have become free of desire; I have burnt away all my sins. ||7||
This is the unique way of the Saints;
they behold the Supreme Lord God with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਲਕਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas aaraadhan har har kiu simarat keejai aalakaa ||8||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, they worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. How could anyone be too lazy to meditate on Him? ||8||
Wherever I look, there I see the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh na visarahu prabh mere suaamee ||
lines.translation: I never forget God, my Lord and Master, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ਬਨਿ ਜਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਾਲਕਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeevahi tere daasaa ban jal pooran thaalakaa ||9||
lines.translation: Your slaves live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord; You are permeating the woods, the water and the land. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tatee vaau na taa kau laagai ||
lines.translation: Even the hot wind does not touch one
who remains awake in meditative remembrance, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: anad binod kare har simaran tis maaiaa sa(n)g na taalakaa ||10||
lines.translation: He delights and enjoys meditative remembrance on the Lord; he has no attachment to Maya. ||10||
Disease, sorrow and pain do not affect him;
he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਖਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa naam dehi prabh preetam sun bena(n)tee khaalakaa ||11||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, O my Beloved Lord God; please listen to my prayer, O Creator. ||11||
Your Name is a jewel, O my Beloved Lord.
Your slaves are imbued with Your Infinite Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਭਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: terai ra(n)g rate tudh jehe virale keee bhaalakaa ||12||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Love, become like You; it is so rare that they are found. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee dhooR maa(n)gai man meraa ||
lines.translation: My mind longs for the dust of the feet of those
who never forget the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g param pad paaee sadaa sa(n)gee har naalakaa ||13||
lines.translation: Associating with them, I obtain the supreme status; the Lord, my Companion, is always with me. ||13||
He alone is my beloved friend and companion,
who implants the Name of the One Lord within, and eradicates evil-mindedness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar tajaae tis jan kau upades niramaalakaa ||14||
lines.translation: Immaculate are the teachings of that humble servant of the Lord, who casts out sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||14||
Other than You, O Lord, no one is mine.
The Guru has led me to grasp the feet of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੰਡਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore jin kha(n)diaa bharam anaalakaa ||15||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru, who has destroyed the illusion of duality. ||15||
With each and every breath, I never forget God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har har kau dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sa(n)t terai ra(n)g raate too samarath vadaalakaa ||16||4||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are imbued with Your Love; You are the great and all-powerful Lord. ||16||4||13||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I enshrine the Lord's lotus feet continually within my heart.
Each and every moment, I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tan man arap dharee sabh aagai jag mahi naam suhaavanaa ||1||
lines.translation: I dedicate my body, mind and everything, and place it in offering before the Lord. His Name is the most beautiful in this world. ||1||
Why forget the Lord and Master from your mind?
He blessed you with body and soul, creating and embellishing you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਰਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saas garaas samaale karataa keetaa apanaa paavanaa ||2||
lines.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, the Creator takes care of His beings, who receive according to what they have done. ||2||
No one returns empty-handed from Him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har rakh man maahee ||
lines.translation: twenty-four hours a day, keep the Lord in your mind.
